scope: Local-only private candidate and simulated integration. No native activation or production change.
implementation: Reuse pinned ParentLease and its close registry:12 existing directory fds plus14 bounded endpoint fds,26 total.

Descriptor-relative nofollow/CLOEXEC checks bind controller and PID1 root views, fixed versioned libsystemd file pin and fixed system bus socket. Library reads are full, bounded and checked against independent supplied path/size/SHA256.
Endpoint binding is borrowed under the current absolute phase deadline. Work cannot consume a global cleanup reserve by using a later binding-read deadline.
Provider injection occurs only after provenance checks. No native provider/loader is supplied, no automatic hash learning or fallback exists.
Guarded connection verifies provenance before Load/Ref/Start and around profile/quiescence. Failures seal new work; original narrowly authorized old-owner cleanup remains available.
Prepared checks bind actual artifact operations, clock, parent fds/stamps, own unit and invocation. Direct close, profile faults and sticky disconnection invalidate aggregate success flags.

Unified in-memory host tests run the original worker protocol through actual OwnedArtifacts and typed ABI decoders, using one bus. READY-time library or socket replacement blocks GO and retains artifacts.

findings.issue: Binding read used the global cleanup deadline during phase work
findings.resolution: borrow(phaseDeadline); no further binding reads after first late stat; provider not invoked

findings.issue: Sticky disconnection could leave aggregate success flags true
findings.resolution: Connection disconnection invalidates both success properties and cannot reconnect

review.additionalSelfReviewFix: Direct connection close and provenance-profile failure now invalidate aggregate success flags; both were reproduced before repair.

testEvidenceNotes: Final batch contains37 stage tests (13 lease,21 endpoint,3 original-worker sessions) and365 selected earlier cases.402 total, no skips or failures.
Earlier400-pass batch predates the two final review fixes and is retained, not added to the final count.
Initial missing-implementation failures do not establish behavioral bug reproduction. Stale success and both review findings have actual failing-before/fixed-after regressions.
All final log hashes, exit codes, expected counts and OK summaries were rechecked; private source binding was recorded separately.
limitations: All filesystem, kernel and bus boundaries were in-memory doubles. Default host operations remain disabled; no native execution entry point is provided.
Metadata equality and supplied file digest do not prove native bus peer credentials, ELF mappings, installed parser/kernel enforcement or systemd version compatibility.
CORE cleanup report precedes separate Endpoint.close. Final acceptance must independently include source-lease closure and errors; backend cleanup alone is insufficient.

A future native assembler must bind the independently checked library loader, namespace setup, one outer acquisition/session deadline, watchdog and final combined cleanup receipt. Current test fixtures are not a VPS entry point.
No new VPS performance/resource or production acceptance is inferred. Product-wide regression was not claimed.
Historical frozen AddRef contract failure remains separately recorded, not rerun or resolved.
synchronization: Sanitized verification only; private candidate implementation, raw logs and credentials are not published.
